note: advisory-chain differential probe: static patch-absence oracle, never a runtime proof
checks: locate the daemon named by the advisory in every extracted rootfs (usr/bin/<daemon>)
require the advisory's listed model to have BOTH an affected and a fixed build in hand
disassemble .text of both with capstone (ARM/Thumb per ELF flags), normalize PC-relative immediates and literal pools
SequenceMatcher over normalized tokens -> fixed-only blocks (patch) / vuln-only blocks (vulnerable code)
token-match the vuln-only blocks (>=5 insns) in every unlisted model's daemon; also report fixed-only matches so a real check is not confused with generic frame arithmetic
false_positive_guard: a fixed-only match must be read, not counted: frame-pointer arithmetic and call setup match trivially
different build hashes / sizes prove nothing by themselves; the claim is patch-absence
no emulator run => no claim about runtime reachability of the overflow
